headline: 6-hour gas supply suspension in parts of Narayanganj and Munshiganj this Friday
summary: Titas Gas will suspend supply from 2pm to 8pm for pipeline relocation work near Pagla Railway Station.
details: Gas supply will be suspended for six hours in six areas of Narayanganj and Munshiganj this Friday.
Titas Gas Transmission and Distribution Company announced the suspension in a press release on Thursday.
The shutdown is necessary to relocate an existing gas pipeline next to the under-construction Bridge No. 7 in the Pagla Railway Station area.
Supply will be cut off for all categories of customers in Fatulla, Enayetnagar, Kashipur, Muktarpur, Munshiganj, and Siddhirganj from 2pm to 8pm.
Titas Gas also warned that customers in surrounding areas may experience low gas pressure during this period.
The company apologized for the temporary inconvenience and stated that efforts will be made to normalize supply as quickly as possible.

headline_marked: 27-year-old [[beaten to death by mob]] over mobile theft allegation in Munshiganj
headline: 27-year-old beaten to death by mob over mobile theft allegation in Munshiganj
summary: The victim was allegedly assaulted by worshippers at a mosque in Sreenagar upazila after several mobile phones went missing during Fajr prayers.
details: A 27-year-old man, identified as Mohammad Shahadat Hossain, was killed after being beaten by a mob in Munshiganj's Sreenagar upazila this morning.
The incident occurred at the Osman Gani Bari Mosque, where several worshippers reported their mobile phones missing during Fajr prayers.
Locals allegedly caught Shahadat on suspicion of involvement in the thefts and beat him indiscriminately, leading to his death at the scene.
Police recovered the body from the road in front of the mosque and sent it to Munshiganj General Hospital for an autopsy.
Additional Superintendent of Police Anisur Rahman stated that police are investigating the circumstances and working to identify those involved in the assault.
According to police, multiple theft cases had previously been filed against Shahadat. Legal action will be taken against the attackers once they are identified.
caption:
A man was beaten to death by a mob in Munshiganj after being accused of stealing mobile phones from worshippers during Fajr prayers.

A 27-year-old man, identified as Mohammad Shahadat Hossain, was killed after being beaten by a mob in Munshiganj's Sreenagar upazila this morning.

The incident occurred at the Osman Gani Bari Mosque, where several worshippers reported their mobile phones missing during Fajr prayers.

Locals allegedly caught Shahadat on suspicion of involvement in the thefts and beat him indiscriminately, leading to his death at the scene.

Police recovered the body from the road in front of the mosque and sent it to Munshiganj General Hospital for an autopsy.

Additional Superintendent of Police Anisur Rahman stated that police are investigating the circumstances and working to identify those involved in the assault.

According to police, multiple theft cases had previously been filed against Shahadat. Legal action will be taken against the attackers once they are identified.
